Also, I want to swap out my jigsaw puzzle for one with the same difficulty but 1000 more pieces. If both an animal theme and an art theme are available, I'd prefer the animal one. Lastly, I need to exchange my camera for a slightly lower resolution model, but I want to keep the other options the same. And I want to cancel the skateboard from my other order. If there's any issue with canceling the skateboard, I'm okay with canceling the whole order. Just to be cautious.
